paragraphs: ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how people interact with technology. You launched the first human‑like AI voice model in early 2023 and now operate three platforms – ElevenAgents for intelligent customer experiences, ElevenCreative for multi‑modal content generation, and ElevenAPI for developer access to audio models. The role sits within Marketing Engineering, forward‑deployed to growth pods where agents are built, measured and made safe for real business work. The focus is on turning prototype agents into reliable, measurable services that the business can depend on, using your own agents platform, orchestration tools and frontier models.

I have built agents that integrate LLM APIs and manage hallucination risks, employing LangChain on AWS and Bedrock to deliver a robust fallback stored as a 19,213‑gene parquet file. This work required translating vague problem statements into production‑ready pipelines, ensuring the system could be called via standard APIs and remain dependable under load. By structuring the agent logic and monitoring its outputs, I demonstrated the ability to move beyond demo‑level implementations to a production environment that other teams could rely upon.

I have delivered agentic solutions using Python, connecting to PostgreSQL and embedding continuous integration to maintain quality. In collaboration with stakeholders I designed an end‑to‑end workflow where the agent performed tasks autonomously, with the codebase versioned and tested through CI pipelines. This experience shows I can apply LLM capabilities within Python‑driven agents, evaluate their performance, and iterate based on measurable outcomes, aligning with the requirement to ship production systems that others depend on.
